recent.title: LOCAL SYSTEM ENVIRONMENT FOR CLOUD BASED DEVELOPMENT
OPTIMIZING CONTAINER STARTUP PERFORMANCE USING BLOCK LAYER STORAGE

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "anyscale", 2026-09-13

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud. The site describes orchestrating model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability.

The site quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale lets his team push the boundaries of generative AI by scaling workloads seamlessly, which he says removes infrastructure risk and lets the team focus on innovation rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. The site also cites an applied AI engineer who said a model could be selected one day and running in production the next, a step the site says would previously have taken a week or more.

The company's record here lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its recorded legal exposure is in California.
